Модель мира — это физический симулятор,: Is a world model a physics simulator, just on a neural network?
Да: она считает те же законы механики, т: Yes: it computes the same laws of mechanics, only faster
Нет: её учат по записям, и она знает тол: No: it's learned from recordings and knows only what was in them; DayDreamer does without a simulator altogether
Нет: модель мира — это просто политика,: No: a world model is just a policy that sees the future
Симулятор урока 4.5 считает законы механ: The simulator of lesson 4.5 computes the laws of mechanics put in by engineers. Ada's world model didn't know that a cup tips over from a fast hit, because that never happened in the recordings.

Авторы PlaNet называют накопление ошибок: The authors of PlaNet name the accumulation of errors in multi-step predictions as one of the key difficulties, and in MBPO long rollouts trained the policy worse than short ones. In Lab 1, the one-step error is under a millimeter, but over a dozen steps of a fast push, imagination drifts off by centimeters.

У Ha и Schmidhuber при самой уверенной м: In Ha and Schmidhuber's work, with the most confident model, the agent almost always won in imagination, but in the real game it survived for less time than a random policy.
